value.answer: Finding a therapist can take a while, so it's good you're starting. If you're in Toronto, the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term therapy for depression and anxiety. Family Service Toronto charges on a sliding scale based on income. Psychotherapy Referral Service can match you with a registered psychotherapist, and First Session offers free consultations to help you find a private one. If you have a workplace benefits plan or an Employee Assistance Program, it may cover sessions too. If things get urgent, ConnexOntario is open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600 and can point you to the right help.
